literature.source: Farsi, Bouziani and Ham, Scientific Reports (2026-08-25), DOI 10.1038/s41598-026-65125-z; arXiv:2507.15787v3
literature.novelty: Differentiable FEM/PDE solver with structure-preserving learnable operator; real-data Ti-6Al-4V shear coupon and synthetic thermal/zero-shot examples.
literature.limitations: One real four-specimen titanium benchmark; reduced scalar damage law due non-identifiability; other material/thermal examples synthetic; adjoint training cost; no UQPU reproduction or Pangola data.
literature.follow_up: Pin Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21251671, reproduce the SFC2 benchmark, then use batch/specimen/geometry holdouts for a specified Pangola mechanical/thermal function.

literature.source: Feng et al., Nature Reviews Methods Primers 6, 81 (2026-10-22), DOI 10.1038/s43586-026-00534-y
literature.novelty: Methods framing of memory, tool use, task decomposition, communication, reproducibility and human-in-the-loop control for agentic science.
literature.limitations: Review/primer, not an experimental UQPU benchmark; hallucination, tool misuse, interpretability and safety remain open.
literature.follow_up: Benchmark fresh-agent continuation from canonical GitHub artifacts only.

literature.source: Jiang and Karniadakis, npj Artificial Intelligence 2, 57 (2026-04-30), DOI 10.1038/s44387-026-00102-5
literature.novelty: Persistent knowledge base and 10+ specialized agents for proposal, critique, retrieval, evaluation and iterative SciML implementation across six curated tasks.
literature.limitations: Reported 10-to->11000x figures are benchmark loss ratios, not speedups; retrieval quality matters; LLM debate is not proof; evaluation overhead and transfer to real experiments remain open.
literature.follow_up: Equal-budget single-agent versus multi-agent known-law and cold-start benchmark with independent evaluator.

literature.novelty: Stochastic LCOE and implied learning-rate analysis across MCF, ICF and MIF maturity stages.
literature.limitations: Preprint; model projections, not observed plant costs; above-30% implied learning-rate output conflicts methodologically with Tang et al. 2-8% experience-rate estimate; full net-electric boundary not yet audited.
literature.follow_up: Reconstruct inputs, FOAK/NOAK and learning definitions; compare like-for-like and add full net-electric/replacement/financing boundary.
